caseStudies.challenge: Order processing, inventory updates, and customer follow-ups were handled manually across three disconnected tools. The ops team spent 30+ hours a week on data entry alone.
caseStudies.solution: Built a FlowForge workflow connecting Shopify, their 3PL, and Klaviyo. Orders now trigger automatic inventory pulls, shipping label generation, and post-purchase sequences without a single human touch.

caseStudies.challenge: Sales reps were spending 3–4 hours daily on lead research, CRM updates, and follow-up scheduling. Pipeline visibility was poor and deals were slipping through the cracks.
caseStudies.solution: Deployed LeadBot Pro to qualify inbound leads, auto-enrich CRM records, and trigger personalized outreach sequences. Reps now only touch leads that are sales-ready.

caseStudies.challenge: Client onboarding required manual data collection, document chasing, and entry into three separate systems. New clients waited up to two weeks before work could begin.
caseStudies.solution: Automated the entire onboarding pipeline with DataSync AI — intake forms feed directly into their practice management software, document requests are triggered automatically, and staff get notified only when everything is complete.
